targets.evidence_quote: Generalizability attempt to evaluate 20 claims from Vermeulen_EurJournPersonality_2010_7RR2
targets.outcome_quote: This claim was replicated. A significant main effect of alexithymia was observed [F(1,1088) = 303.154, p < .001, partial eta squared = .218], with high alexithymia scorers recognizing fewer anger and joy words (M = .191, SE = .011) than low alexithymia scorers (M = .463, SE = .011).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Twenty claims from one original paper; report explicitly replicates the alexithymia main effect and several negative correlations, and explicitly fails the two- and three-way interactions, facilitation index and happy-music joy-word correlations. Quote gives agreeing component; claim 2 explicitly says: This claim was not replicated. No significant interaction between alexithymia level and music type was found [F(1,1088) = 1.448, p = .229, partial eta squared = .001].
